concerns.text: The plan states it will “acquire a time‑resolved human brain single‑cell RNA‑seq atlas” but provides no verified dataset citation (no URL, accession ID, or Verified Datasets block). Without a concrete, reachable source the pipeline cannot be executed, violating FR‑001 (dataset acquisition) and the Constitution’s Verified Accuracy principle. A specific, reachable dataset (e.g., a BrainSpan scRNA‑seq release with a DOI or GEO accession) must be cited and verified before the plan can be accepted.
